verses.t: Om means obedience. When they have been told, 'Om, speak,' they speak.
After Om the Adhvaryu gives the response.
After Om the Brahman-priest gives orders.
After Om he (the sacrificer) allows the performance of the Agnihotra.
When a Brâhmana is going to begin his lecture, he says, 10. 'Om, may I acquire Brahman (the Veda).' He thus acquires the Veda.
